log: Mesh 0 is a scene-grain report (11 components); I named components, not islands, since the report offered that grain.
No part name could be justified beyond shape/position/size/colour; every name is shape-descriptive on purpose. Nothing says what the object is as a whole.

Mesh 1 (transmission+iridescence material): two islands nearly coincident (same 'at' 0.5,0.5,0.5, sizes 0.193 vs 0.190). Nothing separates them by position, so I named them outer/inner by size only; they may really be one thing or two halves; I could not tell.

Mesh 2 (iridescence material) is one island with the same bounding size as mesh 0 component 0 (0.29x0.23x0.30); I take it to be a coating or overlay of that dark body, but that is an inference from size and not proven. Material names used as evidence (not listed in basis): IridescenceLamp, IridescenceLampTransmissionIridescence, IridescenceLampIridescence.

Vane names for components 7-9 rest on three near-identical small pieces at about 120 degrees apart around the axis; component 9 is flat in x (0.003) so it may not be a true member of the set. Left/right/positive-Z are world axes; I do not know which is front.

Component 4 mixes white (71%) and black (29%) and its islands (8,10,16) may be unrelated things joined by touching; component 10 (small black) sits near the base and may belong with it or be a switch/cable; I could not resolve this.
The 'at' values for mesh 1 and 2 are always 0.5 because each is a single mesh-centred cluster, so position gave nothing there.
